create_semseg_dataset: create a SemSegData dataset from a pickle file with configurable sidelength and augmentation options
flip_rotate_voxel_cube: randomly rotate or flip a 3D voxel cube tensor and its labels for data augmentation
fit_schematic_in_sidelength: crop and pad a 3D voxel schematic to fit a fixed sidelength cube with random shifts
organize_semantic_classes: merge rare and plural semantic classes below a minimum occurrence threshold into a unified class map
pad_schematic_to_sidelength: pad a 3D voxel schematic tensor to a target sidelength using PyTorch functional padding
